answer_1.quote: LLM-based role-playing chatbots have been developed to simulate speakers of different personal attributes and linguistic styles so as to provide more immersive interaction with users.

answer_2.quote: we introduce two metrics: (a) Simulation Score, which evaluates the alignment of agent-generated utterances with actual utterances from the target speaker, and (b) Distinction Score, which measures the differences among utterances generated by the same agent model when simulating various speakers.

answer_3.quote: we examine its performance under zero-shot, Chain-of-Thought, and few-shot paradigms.

answer_4.quote: We engage ten human annotators, who are non-experts, to assess whether pairs of conversations or sets of utterances are from the same speaker.
answer_4.guideline: Base your score on the overall impression from the transcripts. Consider factors like word choice, sentence structure, personal consistency, and stylistic elements. Judge it even if evidence is limited; use your expertise to make an informed judgment.
